title: iGEM Registry Bacterial Transformation
author: Tiago Lubiana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rr3d58n

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend DNA from the selected wells in the Distribution Kit with 10 µL ultrapure water.

steps.title: Prepare tubes and ice
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL tubes with the part name or well location, fill a lab ice bucket with ice, and pre‑chill the tubes.

steps.title: Thaw competent cells
steps.instruction: Thaw the competent‑cell stock on ice; this typically takes 10–15 min for a 260 µL stock.

steps.title: Aliquot competent cells
steps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL of the thawed competent cells into each labeled 1.5 mL tube and keep all tubes on ice; include one tube for the control.

steps.title: Add DNA to cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of the resuspended DNA to each experimental tube and 1 µL of control DNA to the control tube.

steps.title: Mix and incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Close the tubes, gently flick or agitate to mix, and incubate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Heat shock
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a 42 °C water bath (ensure tube bottoms are submerged) and heat‑shock for exactly 45 seconds.

steps.title: Post‑heat‑shock ice recovery
steps.instruction: Return the tubes to ice and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add SOC and recover
steps.instruction: Pipette 950 µL SOC medium into each tube, then incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour with shaking at 200–300 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic plates
steps.instruction: Obtain two petri dishes containing the appropriate antibiotics for each construct and one control dish; keep plates agar side up.

steps.title: Spin down and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 6800 g for 3 minutes, discard 800 µL of supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in the remaining 100 µL.

steps.title: Plate cells on agar
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of each resuspended transformation onto the prepared antibiotic plates and spread immediately with a sterilized spreader or glass beads.

steps.title: Incubate plates overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates upside down at 37 °C for 14–18 hours.

steps.title: Pick colonies and downstream
steps.instruction: Pick single colonies, perform colony PCR to verify part size, make glycerol stocks, grow cultures, and perform minipreps.
